steps.account_rows: SELECT id, name, email, encrypted_password, admin, setup_completed, locale, time_zone, display_currency, CASE WHEN confirmation_token IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'minted:' || length(confirmation_token) END AS confirmation_token, confirmation_sent_at, confirmed_at, unconfirmed_email, CASE WHEN reset_password_token IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN reset_password_token = 'f25bf3163e26cbf2b993de13b1380f9f2d521fbdf723fce0caf972c13d1fdcf1' THEN 'seeded' ELSE 'minted:' || length(reset_password_token) END AS reset_password_token, reset_password_sent_at, failed_attempts, locked_at, otp_module, otp_secret_key IS NOT NULL AS otp_seeded, last_otp_at, remember_created_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users ORDER BY id
